# Module 2 — Git

This topic is version control. Java in this folder, if any, may use only the module 1 tools: `main`, variables, primitive types, `String`, operators, `Scanner`, and `System.out`.

Do not suggest or require: `if`, `else`, `switch`, loops, arrays, `enum`, encapsulation, inheritance, interfaces, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, lambda expressions, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not review branching strategy, commit style, or pull-request text beyond a short note when the code is in the wrong folder.
